scripts.preview: npx opennextjs-cloudflare build && node scripts/add-cron.mjs && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npx opennextjs-cloudflare build && node scripts/add-cron.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:providers && npm run db:seed:courses && npm run db:seed:featured && npm run db:seed:paths
scripts.db:bootstrap: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:seed:prod: wrangler d1 execute bytesai-learning-db --remote --file=db/seed/providers.sql && wrangler d1 execute bytesai-learning-db --remote --file=db/seed/courses.sql && wrangler d1 execute bytesai-learning-db --remote --file=db/seed/featured.sql && wrangler d1 execute bytesai-learning-db --remote --file=db/seed/learning_paths.sql
scripts.db:sync:local: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:pull: wrangler d1 export bytesai-learning-db --remote --output=db/prod-dump.sql && echo 'Prod dump saved. Restart dev server to apply.'
